name: Gish Vita: ReVibed
author: isage, AGTS10k
description:
This is a fork of isage's port of Gish to PS Vita, with the purpose of polishing it further into a more playable experience using AI.
Improvements include: restored lighting and shadows, performance optimizations, 4:3 aspect ratio by default, other small fixes.
requirements: - Game data required: Gish 1.6 (non-Steam, MS Windows), Gish 1.53 (non-Steam, Linux), or Gish 1.7 (Steam version).
